items.quote: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
items.claim: Aaron and Hur held up Moses' hands, which remained steady until sunset
items.mechanism: stone placed under him; Aaron and Hur on either side holding up his hands
